app.name: Internal app
app.sample_banner: Sample data. Everything you see here is made up. Built by the scripted engine: fixed changes, no AI model.

sign_in.title: Sign in
sign_in.email_invalid: That does not look like an email address. Check for a missing @ or a typo.
sign_in.wrong_credentials: The email or password is not right. Check both and try again.
sign_in.server_error: Signing in did not work because the server did not answer. Try again in a moment; if it keeps happening, tell your administrator.

home.title: Home
home.nothing_yet_body: This app has no screens for your role yet. The next build step adds them.

no_access.title: You do not have access to this page
no_access.role_not_allowed: You are signed in as {role}. This page is only for: {allowed}.
no_access.role_not_recognised: Your account has no role that this app recognises, so nothing can be shown to you.
no_access.action_refused: Your role is not allowed to do that. Nothing was changed.
no_access.what_to_do: If you think this is a mistake, ask your administrator.

example.restricted_title: Example: a page for HR admins only
example.restricted_body: You can see this page, {name}, because your role is HR admin. No other role can. It is an example of the role check; the build step that adds this app's own screens replaces it.
example.action_title: Example: an action for managers and HR admins
example.action_body: Every signed-in role can open this page. Only a manager or an HR admin can use the button. Your role is {role}.
example.action_done: Done. The example action ran for the role {role}. Nothing was stored.

leave.empty_title: You have no leave requests yet
leave.empty_body: When you ask for leave, your request appears here with its status. Start with a new leave request.
leave.sent: Your request was saved. Its status is Waiting.
leave.problem_start_date_missing: Enter the first day of leave.
leave.problem_start_date_invalid: The first day of leave is not a real date. Pick a date from the calendar.
leave.problem_end_date_missing: Enter the last day of leave.
leave.problem_end_date_invalid: The last day of leave is not a real date. Pick a date from the calendar.
leave.problem_end_before_start: The last day of leave is before the first day. Change one of them so that the last day is the same as the first day or after it.
leave.problem_days_missing: Enter the number of working days you are asking for.
leave.problem_days_not_whole: Working days requested must be a whole number, such as 5.
leave.problem_days_too_few: Working days requested must be at least 1.
leave.problem_days_too_many: Working days requested cannot be more than {max}, the number of calendar days from the first day of leave to the last.
leave.problem_reason_too_long: The reason is too long. Keep it to {max} characters or fewer.
leave.save_failed: Your request was not saved because the server had a problem. Try again in a moment; if it keeps happening, tell your administrator.
